detailed_descriptions.en: just volleyball is an arcade-style action volleyball game that aims to bring a freeform, addicting, and simple volleyball experience to PC, with full online & offline play. with a cursor-based aiming system and fully manual movement, the game may seem simple to pick up, but has a steep and rewarding learning curve. features: 1v1s, 2v2s, 3v3s, 4v4s, 5v5s... and 6v6! play whichever format of volleyball you enjoy the most! offline & online play: practice by yourself with bots, or head online! character customization: personalize your player with a simple yet dynamic avatar creation system. replay mode: review your highlights & capture cinematic moments!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
just volleyball is an arcade-style action volleyball game that aims to bring a freeform, addicting, and simple volleyball experience to PC, with full online & offline play. with a cursor-based aiming system and fully manual movement, the game may seem simple to pick up, but has a steep and rewarding learning curve.

features:

  • 1v1s, 2v2s, 3v3s, 4v4s, 5v5s... and 6v6! play whichever format of volleyball you enjoy the most!

  • offline & online play: practice by yourself with bots, or head online!

  • character customization: personalize your player with a simple yet dynamic avatar creation system.

  • replay mode: review your highlights & capture cinematic moments!
